_doc: Hollow Howler voice per event (concept KONZEPT-HOLLOW-HOWLER-GRUSEL-2026-10-15.md section 10). mode: synth = variant A everywhere (committed synthesis, default), vanilla = variant B everywhere (built from Vanilla at build time), mix = per event as in 'mix'. -PsbHowlerSounds / SB_HOWLER_SOUNDS override mode for one build.
